differentiation_hypotheses: Vietnamese-first onboarding and PayOS support may reduce adoption friction for local buyers; test this with prospects.
BYOK may limit platform AI COGS and reduce provider lock-in, while increasing setup friction for non-technical users; measure both effects.

risks: Zero paying customers means demand, retention, CAC, and unit economics remain unvalidated.

Payment routing or IPN activation failure could block conversion; the protected flow needs explicit end-to-end evidence.
AI provider pricing, availability, licensing, and output quality can change; customers own configured provider accounts and terms.
Solo-founder dependency may constrain sales, support, and incident response.
Vietnam and destination-market privacy, AI, e-commerce, consumer, tax, and securities obligations require current professional review before expansion or fundraising claims.
